program.section_heading: Educational Studies: ECE Unit Concentration Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Apply certificate courses towards entry into a teaching credential program and/or to fulfill requirements for a selected child development permit or an employment setting requiring ECE units.

Upon completion of 16 ECE units, the student will be able to document the acquisition of foundational knowledge and skills (as related to courses selected for the purpose of this certificate), relevant for employment as a teacher assistant or support staff in an early childhood education classroom or related environment.
careers: paraprofessional in early childhood settings with possible inclusion of special education pre-school settings
